'''Nelvaan''' was a frigid [[Outer Rim Territories|Outer Rim]] [[planet]] located in the [[Savareen sector]]'s [[Nelvaan system]]. It was [[Homeworld|home]] to the peaceful, [[Sentience|sentient]] [[Nelvaanian]] [[species]]. During the [[Clone Wars]], the planet's exploitation rights were ceded to the [[Confederacy of Independent Systems]] by [[Onaconda Farr]], the [[Galactic Republic]] [[senator]] of [[Rodia]]. The Confederacy-aligned [[Techno Union]] used the natives to perform experiments, turning them into [[cyborg]] monsters.

==Description==
Nelvaan was a frozen<ref name="AEYNTK" /> [[planet]]<ref name="Rise of the Separatists" /> in the [[Outer Rim Territories]]' [[Nelvaan system]] within the [[Savareen sector]],<ref name="SystemsoftheGalaxy" /> which was located within the [[Trailing Sectors]],<ref name="Rise of the Separatists" /> at [[Standard Galactic Grid|grid]] coordinates Q-16. It was connected to the planets [[Tatooine]], [[Geonosis]], and [[Llanic]]<ref name="TFA Beginner" /> via the [[Triellus Trade Route]]<ref name="SW.com" /> and was the [[homeworld]] of the [[hair]]y [[white bantha]] and the hostile [[Reptile|reptilian]] [[horax]].<ref name="AEYNTK" />

==History==
During the [[Clone Wars]],<ref name="Rise of the Separatists" /> [[Galactic Republic]]<ref name="DB Farr">{{Databank|onaconda-farr|Onaconda Farr}}</ref> [[Senator]] [[Onaconda Farr]] from [[Rodia]] of the Savareen [[sector]] brokered a deal with the [[Confederacy of Independent Systems]] in which Farr would cede exploitation rights to other planets in the sector, such as Nelvaan, [[Christophsis]], and [[Zaadja]], in exchange for [[Foodstuff|food]]. This allowed the [[Techno Union]], a guild aligned with the Confederacy, to experiment on the peaceful [[Nelvaanian]] natives, turning them into [[Brain|mindless]] [[cyborg]] monstrosities.<ref name="Rise of the Separatists" />

==Inhabitants==
Nelvaan was home to the [[Sentience|sentient]] Nelvaanians, a peaceful, low-tech species that fell victim to the experiments of the Techno Union.<ref name="Rise of the Separatists" /> The people of Nelvaan had a special ritual that required young [[Gender|males]] to acquire horax scales, which could be used to make an [[Horax scale elixir|elixir]] with a scent that could repel the large beasts for a [[Standard year|year]], in order to join the ranks of the warriors.<ref name="AEYNTK" />

==Behind the scenes==
Nelvaan was first mentioned in the current ''[[Star Wars]]'' [[canon]] in the [[2015]] reference book ''[[Star Wars: Absolutely Everything You Need to Know]]''.<ref name="AEYNTK" /> The world was originally created for the [[Star Wars Legends|''Star Wars'' Legends]] continuity in the [[2005]] novel ''[[Labyrinth of Evil]]'', written by [[James Luceno]].<ref name="LOE">''[[Labyrinth of Evil]]''</ref> The planet's first Legends appearance came in "[[Chapter 22 (Star Wars: Clone Wars)|Chapter 22]]" of the animated microseries ''[[Star Wars: Clone Wars]]'',<ref name="CW22">{{CW|22}}</ref> which aired on [[March 22]], 2005, on [[Cartoon Network]].<ref name="TV.com">{{TVcom|url=shows/star-wars-clone-wars/chapter-xxii-370294|text=Star Wars: Clone Wars - Season 2, Episode 2: Chapter XXII}}</ref> Nelvaan was named in reference to [[Nelvana]], the animation studio that produced the [[Ewoks (television series)|''Ewoks'']] and [[Star Wars: Droids: The Adventures of R2-D2 and C-3PO|''Droids'']] television series.<ref name="CWVol2">[[Star Wars: Clone Wars Volume Two|''Star Wars: Clone Wars'' Volume Two]] audio commentary</ref>
